providers.name: Lunchbox
providers.decision: Lunchbox owns canonical IDs, user edits, merges, redirects, and field selections.

providers.name: Lunchbox Emulator Catalog
providers.decision: Ship as maintained Lunchbox reference data.

providers.name: Libretro Database
providers.decision: Ship the pinned evidence pack; never use its records as the canonical game catalog.

providers.name: Wikidata
providers.decision: Use for redistribution-safe facts and external-ID crosswalks, not as a complete metadata catalog.

providers.name: IGDB
providers.data_license: IGDB API and Twitch Developer Services terms
providers.decision: Preferred broad metadata lookup after authentication; do not publish an IGDB bulk snapshot.

providers.name: MobyGames
providers.decision: Use as an optional licensed gap source; commercial use requires an appropriate plan and attribution.

providers.name: RAWG
providers.decision: Use only as an optional attributed runtime connector; RAWG prohibits data redistribution.

providers.name: RetroAchievements
providers.data_license: RetroAchievements API terms; bulk-data redistribution not recorded
providers.decision: Use its API for supported hashes and achievements; it is not a universal game catalog.

providers.name: TheGamesDB
providers.decision: Do not integrate until current data and media reuse terms are confirmed in writing.

providers.name: LaunchBox Games Database
providers.decision: Do not ingest or clone its exported database without an explicit reuse grant.

providers.name: OpenVGDB
providers.decision: Retain the local copy for audit only until provenance and redistribution terms are verified.

providers.name: Minerva
providers.decision: Treat torrent and package records as acquisition offers, never canonical game identity.
